Adyen — Data Scientist, Risk (Amsterdam)
Adyen's risk team builds the machine-learning models that decide in milliseconds whether a payment is fraudulent.
You will design, train and deploy gradient-boosted and deep-learning models on billions of transactions, own features end to end in production, and run experiments with product teams.
What we look for:
- MSc or PhD in computer science, statistics, physics or a related quantitative field
- 3+ years of experience building and deploying ML models in production
- Expert Python and SQL; experience with Spark or similar distributed data tools
- Strong grasp of statistics and experimental design
- Experience with fraud, risk or payments data is a plus
Fluent English required.
